headline: Anthropic releases Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2, reporting broad technical gains
summary: Anthropic announced Claude Fable 5.2 for general access and the more restricted Claude Mythos 5.2 on Nov 9, 2026. Its release reports broad gains on coding, agentic science, cybersecurity, biology, robotics and hardware tasks, as well as a 30-hour, roughly 1,000-agent Lean formalization of Fermat’s Last Theorem. A linked Nov 7 physics preprint attributes a reported weak-coupling Hawking–Page result to an internal Claude model, with a physicist checking known cases and a second Claude computation agreeing. These are significant first-party claims and an author-attributed preprint; benchmark replication, independent scientific review, and transfer to general capability remain open.
